purpose: Small behavioral smoke of the blind-api-eval workflow, not a population estimate
trial_budget: One fresh consumer per development task per round; reduced repetition recorded. One final holdout.
acceptance: Every valid task passes the independent oracle and critical criterion; candidate rubric score 100 per task in two consecutive rounds; holdout passes. No unassessed attempts count as passes.
isolation: procedural; fresh context, staged public files, explicit read allowlist, shared host filesystem
settings: Inherited parent model; fresh fork_turns none; no model override
candidate_hypothesis: Document literal-key grammar and make syntax diagnostics actionable; same executable semantics
